1.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_001
1.description: The exodus is upon us and things here are rather hectic. If you have business with me, please make it quick.

2.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_002
2.description: I've heard about your mission to the edge of existence. If there's anything I can do for you, please let me know.

3.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_003
3.description: I thank you for plucking our star from the jaws of destruction. If there's anything I can do for you, please let me know.

6.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_A1_000_002
6.description: What kind of place is this?

8.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_010
8.description: I am an archivist at the Archeion. I inspect all that is sent here to be stored, and judge the threat they may pose.

9.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_011
9.description: From cursed relics to disease-bearing creatures, we house some extremely hazardous materials. Such specimens must be kept securely sealed.

10.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_012
10.description: Alas, a new variety of woodworm was recently allowed to run rampant... 'Twas a gross oversight, and we owe Shaggles a great debt for helping to bring the situation under control.

11.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_020
11.description: This is the Archeion, a structure built for the purpose of safely and securely housing all manner of specimens, both animate and inanimate.

12.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_021
12.description: Together with the literary archive of Noumenon, it houses much of Sharlayan's gathered knowledge─a veritable treasure trove of mankind's accumulated wisdom.

13.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_022
13.description: Since the exodus has been set in motion, however, the collection must be moved. That a day should come when everything is thus uprooted...

14.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_023
14.description: Now that you have eradicated the threat to the star, things have largely returned to normal at our facility.

15.name: TEXT_REGNOT5THEARCHEION_00741_SHUSHUTABY_000_024
15.description: It came as a great relief. Had the exodus gone ahead, we would have been forced to make the difficult decision to leave many specimens behind.
